name: Acid Spit
body:
School evocation [acid]; Level druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (fur and a glass rod)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 3 rounds
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, you spit acid in the face of one creature, dealing 1d6 points of damage per level (maximum 10d6). If the target has eyes and is not somehow protected, the spell also blinds the target. A successful saving throw reduces the damage by half and negates the blindness.

On the second round, the spell deals half its original damage, and on the third round it deals half that again (the damage in the second and third rounds is further reduced if the target made its save).

If a target of this spell spends a full round washing the affected area in water (or similar liquid) the spell (including blindness) will be negated.
